posts.headline: The draft is in the books, the excuses are gone, and now Thicks has to prove that ring wasn't a two-season fluke propped up by a 14-14 career mark.
posts.detail: #FreeMaxx Champions is the reigning champ with exactly ONE title in two seasons and an average finish of 5.5 — that's not dynasty math, that's a team living off one great October.

posts.headline: Eighteen straight editions of torching One Nut Barner and Put it in Ra STILL hasn't said a word — that silence is starting to sound like fear.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record with back-to-back top-2 finishes and ZERO titles is the most Cowboys-coded stat line in this entire league — all that regular-season swagger and nothing to show for it when it matters.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh drafted from the deepest hole in the league and the untalented tenth has officially run out of preseason to hide in.
posts.detail: A 4-10 record and a dead-last 12th-place finish is the floor of this entire league — one more season like that and 'untalented tenth' stops being a joke and starts being a permanent title.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Nobody's circling Easy way or the Hard Way on the calendar, and a 10th-place debut says they shouldn't.
posts.detail: Pharaoh23 finished season one at 6-8 with a 10th-place slot — respectable enough to avoid the basement, forgettable enough that this preseason nobody's talking about them, including me until just now.

posts.headline: Seven editions deep and Big Head's title is still getting the fluke treatment — a losing 13-15 career record under a championship banner is the weirdest résumé in this league.
posts.detail: Sasinci's World owns a ring but also an average finish of 5.5 and a sub-.500 record — either that title was lightning in a bottle, or Alxgalvn's about to prove six straight editions of doubt wrong.
